name: The Tower of Althalaxx
summary: Delgren's crusade against the Tower of Althalaxx cultists reaches its sixth chapter. From Maestra's Post, he deciphers orcish writings recovered from the cult's emissaries and learns that Athrikus Narassin hid two trapped Highborne soulgems in satyr strongholds deep in Ashenvale. Champions head to Night Run and Satyrnaar to shatter the vessels, free the tormented spirits, and weaken Athrikus's power.

sections.title: Deciphering the Scribblings
sections.body: Delgren the Purifier puts his study of Orcish to use after Ilkrud Magthrull, an orcish courier, is cut down. His peers in the Holy Light often scoffed at learning an adversary's tongue, but Delgren's practical insight lets him decipher notes recovered from the cult's emissaries. They reveal that Athrikus Narassin hid two potent soulgems containing ancient Highborne essences far to the northeast, in the defiled groves of Night Run and Satyrnaar.

sections.title: Unholy Alliances
sections.body: The soulgems in satyr camps reveal a foul alliance between Athrikus's cabal and demonic scions of the Burning Legion. Bound above circles of imprisonment, the ancient spirits endure endless torment as they fuel dark spellcraft. The blood-soaked satyr altars hold wild demonic corruption, while hidden satyr stalkers sworn to guard these arcane conduits wait in the shadows.

sections.title: Weakening Athrikus
sections.body: Shattering the crimson stones and freeing the Highborne souls from their circles of agony deals a devastating blow to Athrikus's reservoir of mystic strength. Delgren says the leader of the Althalaxx cult is severely weakened without the soulgems. The deed leaves the holy crusader unsettled by the night elves' quiet unease about the satyrs, and he resolves to bring the lingering demonic blight to Auberdine's leaders.

faq.q: Why does Delgren know how to read Orcish?
faq.answer: Delgren took the initiative to study Orcish, though others in his holy order ridiculed him. He believed an enemy's tongue could offer tactical insight, and that knowledge let him translate the notes recovered from Ilkrud Magthrull.

faq.q: What are the soulgems and why are they held by satyrs?
aliases: why do satyrs have the gems
faq.answer: The soulgems are crimson focus stones that bind ancient Highborne spirits, suspended over ritual circles of imprisonment. Athrikus Narassin bargained for them or placed them in sanctuaries such as Night Run and Satyrnaar, where their misery fuels the cult's arcane power.

faq.q: Where are Night Run and Satyrnaar located?
faq.answer: Night Run and Satyrnaar are satyr strongholds in northeastern Ashenvale's forested heights, east of Maestra's Post.

faq.q: Why are the night elves reluctant to talk about the satyrs?
faq.answer: Delgren notices that his elven hosts avoid discussing the satyrs because they were once night elves. During the ancient War of the Ancients, they surrendered to demonic corruption and were warped into goat-legged fiends, an enduring source of grief and shame for the Kaldorei.

faq.q: How does freeing these souls help stop the Tower of Althalaxx cult?
faq.answer: Athrikus Narassin draws on the spiritual energy held in the Highborne soulgems to power his rituals. Shattering the gems frees the trapped souls and starves those rituals of power, leaving him vulnerable to an assault at the tower.

faq.q: Who is Elissa that Delgren mentions speaking to?
faq.answer: Elissa Starbreeze is a prominent night elf Sentinel stationed in Auberdine, where she coordinates local defenses in Darkshore. Delgren plans to confer with her about the entrenched satyr threat to northern Kalimdor.

angles.text: Delgren the Purifier is a pragmatic holy crusader who studies his foes' language to uncover demonic corruption and cleanse the tormented dead.
As a night elf, freeing Highborne ancestors from satyr desecration is a solemn duty that confronts the tragic remnants of your people's ancient past.
Shattering the circles of imprisonment brings peace to spirits suffering centuries of demonic torment.
